ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program students, specifically for Undeclared students the priority registration period, and then seats will open for LAS EOP and PAP students. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 2002 Lincoln Hall to be placed on the waiting list.
